sorted.story: sorted started with a shoot in Diu for CrayWingz. Over 5 days we shot a documentary, more than an hour of podcast and over 30 testimonials, plus a lot of photos, and came home with 3 TB. I built the first version to sort that pile for our designers, and for the editors, because there were several videos to cut. It helped the designers a little. Then I built an editing module. On a later product shoot for Dr. Naturals we felt the need for product photo sorting and for something that sorts while you shoot, so I built product sorting and the Live module.

retain-plus.lesson: The first Monday it got a number wrong, nothing had crashed. One request failed quietly and the email went out with last week's count. Now every number in the email can be confirmed or flagged by the person reading it, in one click.

classified.title: How it works
steps: Every client is on a retainer: a set number of reels and posts a month.
Each week Retain+ reads the client's public Instagram grid, collab posts included.
It counts what went out and checks it against what the retainer promised.
Monday morning, each account manager gets one email: on track, or behind and by how much.
Every number in that email can be confirmed or flagged in one click.
classified.note: Screens stay private. They show client names and their numbers.
